meta.unit: kg CO2e per kWh of electricity
notes: These are grid averages for electricity generation. They do not include transmission and distribution losses.

India uses the Central Electricity Authority (CEA) figure, which counts CO2 only. The other regions use Ember / Energy Institute data via Our World in Data, which counts CO2e. The two bases are close but not identical.
India's regional grids were merged into one national grid in 2013, so India has a single national figure. Sub-national codes such as IN-UP fall back to IN.
